lesson.title: The Moral of the Story
lesson.text: Hard work beats talent only when talent stops trying.

scenes.text: Once upon a time, a tortoise challenged a hare to a race.
The hare laughed and quickly ran far ahead.
He looked back. The tortoise was nowhere to be seen.
The hare found a cool tree and sat down to rest.
The hare stretched his legs. He took a deep breath. He enjoyed the cool shade.
Then he smiled, stood up, and kept running.
When the tortoise reached the finish line, the hare was already waiting there.
